objective: Bring the Calix mark into the application and let the user choose its colour, in the settings and from the control surface.

the_pack.geometry: a chalice whose cup is a scallop shell, one geometry in two colourways
the_pack.tokens: the Gnosix DS tokens, taken as they are: no re-light, no re-tint
the_pack.provenance: the pack regenerates itself from src/paths.json and carries its own SHA256SUMS

the_decision.the_colour_follows: the mark and the accent of the interface, and the focus ring with them
the_decision.the_colour_does_not_follow: the source badges (an ecosystem, not a brand), the semantic colours, the surfaces
the_decision.the_system_icon: Signal Orange, because the launcher reads a system file that a per-user setting cannot reach
the_decision.the_in_application_mark: the single-path mono master, painted by the accent, so it follows the choice without a second asset

what_changed: Calix.Ui.Gpui/src/brand.rs: the two colourways, their tokens, and the parsing of the setting
Calix.Ui.Gpui/src/theme.rs: Theme::with_brand paints the accent, its hover and the focus ring
Calix.Ui.Gpui/src/config.rs: the brand-color setting, in the registry, in the reset table and in the persisted state
Calix.Ui.Gpui/src/views/settings.rs: the Brand Colour row, two swatches, in the appearance section
Calix.Ui.Gpui/src/views/workspace.rs: every theme rebuild carries the brand
Calix.Ui.Gpui/src/icons/calix.svg: the mono currentColor master, painted by the accent
Calix.Ui.Gpui/assets/: the Signal Orange colour master and the hicolor tree
PKGBUILD-calix: the icon tree is installed under the application id

runtime_evidence.the_settings_row: settings-brand-row-crop.png, in the appearance section, with the two swatches
runtime_evidence.the_control_surface: calix-gpui settings set brand-color royal changes the mark and the accent of the running application, live, and the value is persisted in ~/.config/calix/gpui-ui.json

tests.brand: the two colourways parse from their keys; the tokens are the design system's; the colourway is written as its key
tests.theme: the brand paints the accent, the hover and the focus ring, and leaves the rest of the palette alone
tests.config: the colour round-trips through the persisted state, is part of the settings registry, and an unknown colour is refused
tests.settings: the colour is a draft change like the other toggles: it marks the settings unsaved until the user saves

known_gaps: The click on a swatch could not be exercised on this desktop: the synthetic pointer events never reach the Wayland client, so the wheel does not scroll and the clicks do not land. The click path is covered by the unit test on the draft and by the theme test; the runtime proof is the control surface's path, which writes the same state and rebuilds the same theme.
The window the capture was taken in was resized by the compositor, which the application follows (the v0.2.3 fix); the geometry invariants hold at every width that was measured.
